The 1937–38 [[Primeira Liga|Campeonato da Liga]] was the fourth season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Portugal]]. Although the first national competition (in a knock-out cup format) was still called [[Taça de Portugal#1922–1938: Campeonato de Portugal|Portuguese Championship]], the Primeira Liga winners are considered the national champions.<ref>{{cite news|title=FPF confirms: Sporting only have 18 national titles|url=http://observador.pt/2016/12/16/federacao-confirma-sporting-tem-18-e-nao-22-titulos-de-campeao/|access-date=1 March 2017|website=Observador|date=16 December 2016}}</ref>

==Overview==
It was contested by 8 teams, and [[S.L. Benfica]] won the championship.
